record.question: Complete the sentences correctly using one of the alternatives given: __________ had made an attempt
record.explanation: Answer D: All but her. “All but her” means everyone except her; the phrase is the grammatical subject of “had made.” Independent check: “But” means except and functions as a preposition here, taking the object form “her”; option D has no erroneous comma. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/prepositions-and-particles. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
